arguments.script: var setup=UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.GetSceneManagerSetup();var lines=new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();foreach(var n in new[]{"Level01","Level02_Jungle","Level03_Beach","Level04_Town"}){var s=UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.OpenScene("Assets/Scenes/"+n+".unity");foreach(var r in s.GetRootGameObjects().SelectMany(g=>g.GetComponentsInChildren<UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer>(true)).Where(r=>r.sprite!=null&&(r.GetComponentsInParent<UnityEngine.Transform>(true).Any(t=>t.name=="Terrain")||r.GetComponentInParent<DonutFallPlatform>()||r.GetComponentInParent<OrbitRidePlatform>())))lines.Add(n+" "+r.name+" "+UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(r.sprite)+" size="+r.bounds.size);foreach(var m in s.GetRootGameObjects().SelectMany(g=>g.GetComponentsInChildren<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tilemap>()))foreach(var t in m.GetUsedTilesCount()>0?Enumerable.Range(0,1):Enumerable.Empty<int>())lines.Add(n+" map="+m.name+" tiles="+m.GetUsedTilesCount());}UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.RestoreSceneManagerSetup(setup);System.IO.File.WriteAllLines("scripts/rock-terrain-20261111/remaining.txt",lines);
arguments.summary: Audit remaining terrain visuals in first four levels
